lines.en: I walk low along the riverbank.
My long snout nearly touches the water.
My foreclaws hang before my chest.
My toes part the mud.
I test the depth with each step.
Shallow water parts around me.
I walk between the reeds and the water.
My tail cuts a line in the water.
I lower my head to sniff the bank.
Something moves at the bend.
I stop, one foot still raised.
Crossing the shallows is loud.
I skirt a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着湿滑的石头
lines.en: My claws grip the wet stones.

lines.zh: 我泡在河里，只露出背脊。
lines.en: I soak in the river with only my spine showing.
The water mirrors my long snout.
My foreclaws are slightly bent.
Fish pass beneath. I don't move.
There are prints in the bank mud.
I lower my head to the surface.
The water is cool and pleasant.

lines.zh: 我在听水流以外的地方
lines.en: I listen past the sound of the water.
An old scar runs along my back.
I slowly shift my weight.
Mist on the river. I can't see far.
I wait for a ripple on the surface.
There's only the water here.
I lift my tail and shake off water.
I raise my head from the water at you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，鞋已经湿了
lines.en: You're on the bank, boots already wet.
My snout is long. The teeth are inside.
The waterside is mine.
Dry ground won't save you.
I can come ashore, and much faster.
Your shadow falls on the water.

lines.zh: 我半身出水，朝你迈了半步。
lines.en: Half out of the water, I take half a step toward you.
The water only reaches half my leg.
That stick in your hand is too short.
I'm judging your distance from the water.
This distance isn't far.
I lurch aside and the water sprays.
A new cut on my hide.
I back into deeper water.
Threads of blood swirl in the shallows.
I growl once, short.

lines.zh: 我的长吻专抓河里的鱼。
lines.en: My long snout is made for river fish.
The amphibious baryonyx shakes off water.
The water washes it away.
You really hit hard.
But I'm still standing.
What are you holding up on the bank?
Fish smells stronger than that.
I eat what's in the water.
That's not one mouthful for me.
I lower my head, then raise it.
Set it down and I'll consider.
It's much cooler in the water.
Put the fish down and back onto the bank.
I come close only to see clearly.
Don't reach out. I'll take it for a fish.
You hit me and water sprays up.

lines.zh: 我的身子比看上去结实
lines.en: I'm sturdier than I look.
You're shoved into the water.
I step back, mud over my toes.
That shifted me half a step.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，河底的泥翻起来。
lines.en: We collide, and the riverbed mud churns up.
I wade past you.

lines.zh: 我的长尾在水面横扫过去。
lines.en: My long tail sweeps across the water's surface.
You can't grip my hide.
One more touch and I use teeth.

lines.zh: 这一截河道够我们两个
lines.en: This stretch of river is enough for two.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我在浅滩等你。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I wait in the shallows.
We'll take turns watching the bend.
My snout can reach into the mud.
You can't catch fish as fast as I can.
The water's cool. Come in.
The river rises when it rains.
Then we move to higher ground.
I know these banks well.
Follow my tracks.
I dip my head, snatch it up, and shake off the water.
It's gone soft in the water.

lines.zh: 我用带钩的前爪按住鱼骨。
lines.en: I pin the fish bone with my hooked foreclaw.
Too heavy. I drag it a while and drop it.
You dropped it; it drifted to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我把猎物甩上泥岸，压住。
lines.en: I fling the catch onto the muddy bank and pin it.
I look at whatever's in the water.
This piece of wood has no meat in it.
I hold it a moment, then spit it out.
No use keeping it either.

lines.zh: 你踏进浅滩，水纹传到我。
lines.en: You wade into the shallows; the ripples reach me.
I lower myself, ready to lunge.
The water will slow your feet.
My toes grip the mud.
This bite is for your legs.
To reach the bank, you must pass me.
There's no way out at the bend.
Amphibious. I chase on land and in water.
You've gone too far from the water.
No — I've come too close to you.

lines.zh: 你越过我的河界，退不回去。
lines.en: You crossed my river line; there is no going back.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，准备踏水。
lines.en: I lift one foot, ready to splash down.
The splash will reach you first.
And then me.
I track you along the bank.
You take one step; I take two.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，盯着你的脚。
lines.en: I skim the water, eyes on your feet.

lines.zh: 我踩着河床，泥浆没出声。
lines.en: I walk the riverbed, the mud muffling my steps.
You look back and I stop.
You look away and I close in.
This distance is enough.
The mud ahead is soft.
Step there and you'll sink.
So you can only slow down.
This is what I waited for. At the water's edge.
My foreclaw is raised.
Water slides off my back.
My steps are in that water sound.
Right there on your right.

lines.zh: 我已经到岸边了，两栖不费劲。
lines.en: I'm already at the bank. Amphibious, no effort.
I'm not waiting any longer.

lines.zh: 我的长吻咬住你的小腿
lines.en: My long snout clamps your calf.
My foreclaw rakes your leg guard.
This shove puts you in the water.
The splash goes high.

lines.zh: 我把你按进水里，别挣扎。
lines.en: I push you under—stop struggling.
I turn and my tail sweeps round.
Your blade swings slow in water.
My toes dig into the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我的长吻夹住你的靴尖。
lines.en: My long snout clamps on your boot tip.
You retreat; the water's at my waist.
The river is my ground.
Every step of mine is surer.
Tooth marks on your armour.
I lift my foreclaw again.
Then the second bite.
You're about to lose your feet.

lines.zh: 我从河湾的雾里走出来
lines.en: I come out of the mist at the bend.

lines.zh: 这一片河岸有我的脚印
lines.en: My tracks are on this bank already.
One or two of us arrive.
First I test the depth.
Water covers my toes.

lines.zh: 我的长吻在雾里露出来
lines.en: My long snout shows through the mist.
The fish in the river scatter.
I patrol this bank.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩起身，水顺着背流。
lines.en: I rise from the shallows, water streaming off my back.
Prints nearby. Not mine.
I lower my head.
I follow the smell along.
The river is still flowing.
I head slowly upstream.

lines.zh: 两栖的我在河岸上，先看见了。
lines.en: Amphibious, on the bank, I saw it first.
I quicken a little.
The heat tightens my hide.

lines.zh: 我摔进浅水，砸出大水花
lines.en: I crash into the shallows in a great splash.

lines.zh: 水一下没过头，我拼命挣
lines.en: Water closes over me; I struggle hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀上泥岸，摔得发晕。
lines.en: The blast throws me onto the muddy bank, dazed.
An arrow sinks into my shoulder.
That light burns even through the water.

lines.zh: 饿得连河岸都爬不上去
lines.en: Too starved to climb the bank.

lines.zh: 雷从水面窜进我的鳞里
lines.en: Lightning jumps from the water into my scales.
The water's gone and I fall.
